dct_description_sm:
This data set includes the coordinates of the fire stations of the fire department of the City of Montreal. 

The data set [Barracks Administrative Territories] (/city-of-montreal/territories-administratifs-des-barracks) provides the territory covered by the barracks.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
